title.en: Equilibrium in physical and chemical processes

heading.en: Why does a closed bottle of water never dry up?

hook.en: In a closed bottle, water keeps evaporating and vapour keeps condensing. Nothing seems to change, yet molecules are always on the move.
hook.kn: ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಬಾಟಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಆವಿಯಾಗುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ, ಆವಿ ಸಾಂದ್ರೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಏನೂ ಬದಲಾಗದಂತೆ ಕಂಡರೂ ಅಣುಗಳು ಸದಾ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Recognise equilibrium in phase changes and in dissolution
Explain why chemical equilibrium is dynamic
State the general characteristics of equilibrium

narration.en: In a closed bottle, water keeps evaporating and vapour keeps condensing. Nothing seems to change, yet molecules are always on the move.
narration.kn: ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಬಾಟಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಆವಿಯಾಗುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ, ಆವಿ ಸಾಂದ್ರೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ಏನೂ ಬದಲಾಗದಂತೆ ಕಂಡರೂ ಅಣುಗಳು ಸದಾ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: When two opposing physical processes go on at the same rate in a closed system, the system is in physical equilibrium. Ice and water coexist at 273 K and 1 atm; water and its vapour reach a constant vapour pressure; a saturated solution holds solid in equilibrium with dissolved solute. For a gas in a liquid, Henry's law says the mass dissolved is proportional to the pressure of the gas above it.
body.kn: ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಭೌತಿಕ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದಾಗ ಭೌತಿಕ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. 273 K ಮತ್ತು 1 atm ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಜುಗಡ್ಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರು ಜೊತೆಯಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Solid ⇌ liquid: ice ⇌ water at the melting point
Liquid ⇌ vapour: rate of evaporation = rate of condensation
Gas ⇌ solution: Henry's law, m ∝ p

narration.en: When two opposing physical processes go on at the same rate in a closed system, the system is in physical equilibrium. Ice and water coexist at 273 K and 1 atm; water and its vapour reach a constant vapour pressure; a saturated solution holds solid in equilibrium with dissolved solute. For a gas in a liquid, Henry's law says the mass dissolved is proportional to the pressure of the gas above it.
narration.kn: ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಭೌತಿಕ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ದರದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದಾಗ ಭೌತಿಕ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. 273 K ಮತ್ತು 1 atm ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂಜುಗಡ್ಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರು ಜೊತೆಯಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: In a closed flask, water evaporates and vapour condenses. When the two rates become equal, the vapour pressure stops changing, but both processes go on.
In a reversible reaction the forward rate falls as reactants are used up, and the backward rate rises as products build up. Where they meet, equilibrium is reached.
For hydrogen and iodine forming hydrogen iodide, the concentrations level off. After that they stay constant, though molecules keep reacting both ways.
Equilibrium can be reached from either side, only in a closed system, and a catalyst speeds up both directions equally without moving it.

body.en: In a reversible reaction in a closed vessel, the forward rate falls and the backward rate rises until they become equal. After that the concentrations stay constant, but both reactions continue. Using deuterium in the Haber process shows this: deuterated ammonia appears even after equilibrium is reached.
body.kn: ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ಪಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಮುಮ್ಮುಖ ದರ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ದರ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ; ಎರಡೂ ಸಮವಾದಾಗ ಸಮತೋಲನ. ಸಾರತೆಗಳು ಸ್ಥಿರ, ಆದರೆ ಎರಡೂ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Equilibrium can be reached from either side

caption.en: Molecules leave and rejoin the liquid all the time. In a closed container the two rates become equal: that is liquid–vapour equilibrium.

tryThis.en: Watch the vapour above the liquid: the number of molecules stops changing even though they keep moving.

Raise both constants together (a catalyst): K stays the same, but equilibrium comes sooner.

problem.en: 2.0 mol H₂ and 2.0 mol I₂ are heated in a closed flask. At equilibrium 3.0 mol HI is present. How many moles of H₂ and I₂ remain?

steps.en: H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI: every 2 mol HI formed uses 1 mol H₂ and 1 mol I₂.
3.0 mol HI formed, so 1.5 mol H₂ and 1.5 mol I₂ were used.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. 2.0 mol H₂ and 2.0 mol I₂ are heated in a closed flask. At equilibrium 3.0 mol HI is present. How many moles of H₂ and I₂ remain?
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two competitive-exam pattern questions. Try them before we discuss.

points.en: Equilibrium needs a closed system and two opposing processes.
points.kn: ಸಮತೋಲನಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಬೇಕು.

points.en: At equilibrium the forward and backward rates are equal.
points.kn: ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಮ್ಮುಖ ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ದರಗಳು ಸಮ.

points.en: Henry's law: the solubility of a gas is proportional to its pressure.
points.kn: ಹೆನ್ರಿ ನಿಯಮ: ಅನಿಲದ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯತೆ ಅದರ ಒತ್ತಡಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ.

homework.en: Give two examples each of physical and chemical equilibrium from daily life.

narration.en: Recap. Equilibrium needs a closed system and two opposing processes. At equilibrium the forward and backward rates are equal. Equilibrium is dynamic, not static. Henry's law: the solubility of a gas is proportional to its pressure.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಮತೋಲನಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ಬೇಕು. ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಮ್ಮುಖ ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ದರಗಳು ಸಮ. ಸಮತೋಲನ ಚಲನಶೀಲ, ಸ್ಥಿರವಲ್ಲ. ಹೆನ್ರಿ ನಿಯಮ: ಅನಿಲದ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯತೆ ಅದರ ಒತ್ತಡಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ.
